reconciliation_notes: The historical report referenced 3,200 training sources by naive subtraction (5000 - 300 - 1500 = 3200). The actual code implementation in rewm/data.py:split_paths partitions 5,000 sources as 60% train (3,000), 10% val (500), and 30% test (1,500). train.py uses all 3,000 training sources and validates on the first 300 validation sources (n_val=300). The held-out test split of 1,500 sources generates exactly 3,000 balanced evaluation samples (1 negative and 1 positive per source).
